work/1SUO_out/1SUO.tcl.payload:
proc highlighting { colorId representation id selection } {
   puts "highlighting $id"
   mol representation $representation
   mol material "Diffuse" 
    mol color $colorId
   mol selection $selection
   mol addrep $id
}

set id [mol new 1SUO_out.pdb type pdb]
mol delrep top $id
highlighting Name "Lines" $id "protein"
highlighting Name "Licorice" $id "not protein and not resname STP"
highlighting Element "NewCartoon" $id "protein"
highlighting "ColorID 7" "VdW 0.4" $id "protein and occupancy>0.95"
set id [mol new 1SUO_pockets.pqr type pqr]
                        mol selection "all" 
                         mol material "Glass3" 
                         mol delrep top $id 
                         mol representation "QuickSurf 0.3" 
                         mol color ResId $id 
                         mol addrep $id 
highlighting Index "Points 1" $id "resname STP"
display rendermode GLSL

capture.captured_from: real fpocket run executed by the pinned SIF through the family run.sh
capture.scheduler: none - executed locally through apptainer, so no Slurm allocation or task-store status row exists for this capture

upstream.build: make: builds the bundled qhull static library, then links bin/fpocket (and bin/tpocket, bin/dpocket, which this Runner drops) from gcc plus the in-tree VMD molfile static library. No network access and no external netcdf/GSL is required.

bundled_third_party.molfile_plugin: plugins/LINUXAMD64/molfile/libmolfile_plugin.a plus the public header plugins/include/molfile_plugin.h; both carry the University of Illinois Board of Trustees copyright notice (UIUC open-source terms), reproduced in the header itself
bundled_third_party.qhull: src/qhull, released under the Qhull license reproduced in QHULL_COPYING.txt

upstream.model_terms: fpocket ships no trained model or checkpoint; pocket detection is a Voronoi/alpha-sphere algorithm, so there are no separate model terms.

limitations: fpocket scores pockets by alpha-sphere geometry and residue composition; a detected pocket is a candidate site, not a confirmed binding site.
Pockets are emitted in descending fpocket score order; higher scores are more favourable. The leading pocket is the strongest candidate.

The druggability score is a separate, paper-calibrated logistic descriptor in [0, 1]; it has been reoptimized relative to the original publication and REvoCompute does not apply a decision threshold to it.
Pocket centres are the mean of the pocket's alpha-sphere centres, the barycenter fpocket reports internally.
Volume is the upstream Monte-Carlo estimate, whose precision is set by the volume iteration parameter.
Pocket scores, druggability, volume, SASA, centre coordinates, and contact sets are the values fpocket reported for this structure; REvoCompute presents them and does not itself validate them.
